text_en: Praise the Lord ! Praise, O servants of the Lord ; praise the name of the Lord .
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！ 上主的仆人，请一齐赞颂， 请一齐赞颂上主的圣名！

text_en: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time on and forevermore.
text_cn: 愿上主的圣名受赞颂， 从现今直到永远无穷！

text_en: From the rising of the sun to its setting the name of the Lord is to be praised.
text_cn: 从太阳东升直到西倾， 愿上主的圣名受赞颂！

text_en: The Lord is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
text_cn: 上主高越列国万邦， 他的光荣凌驾穹苍；

text_en: Who is like the Lord our God, who is seated on high,
text_cn: 谁能相似上主我们的天主？他坐在苍天之上的最高处。

text_en: who looks far down on the heavens and the earth?
text_cn: 他必会垂目下视， 观看上天和下地；

text_en: He raises the poor from the dust, and lifts the needy from the ash heap,
text_cn: 从尘埃里提拔弱小的人， 由粪土中举扬穷苦的人，

text_en: to make them sit with princes, with the princes of his people.
text_cn: 叫他与贵族的人共席， 也与本国的王侯同位；

text_en: He gives the barren woman a home, making her the joyous mother of children. Praise the Lord !
text_cn: 使那不孕的妇女坐镇家中， 成为多子的母亲，快乐无穷。
